title: Future Quest #7 DC Comics January 2017 Hanna-Barbera Jonny Quest Jeff Parker
conditionDescription: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Future Quest #7 (cover date January 2017, on sale November 2016), DC Comics - the Hanna-Barbera action-hero crossover: Jonny Quest, Space Ghost, the Herculoids, Birdman, Frankenstein Jr. and more. Jeff Parker story; art by Evan Shaner, Ron Randall and Steve Lieber, colors by Veronica Gandini. Direct sales, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Suicide Squad Extended Cut Blu-ray ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
